items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Yeah, I got a record I made with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, I got a record I made with him. Oh yeah? Yeah. I got the record here. The only record I got was an old Brunswick record. And I played it some time ago but I don't know if it got wonk, it don't sound so good no more.
Teddy Wilson was on it. Was he any good then? Yeah, he played fine.
When he first came to New York, he was one of his first, I guess one of his first record dates. I got the record here. I like to hear a good machine sometime but I think-
